label: Every being contingent at w has a distinct CAUSE_2 of its esse
paraphrase: OPEN bridge (B2), analyst formulation, attribution deferred: every candidate that exists at w and is absent at some world accessible from w (MODAL_CONTINGENCY_1) has some other being that causes its esse (CausesIn at esse, CAUSE_2, mode not fixed). The cause is not required to exist at w, to be concrete or to be an efficient cause; it is the weakest form the causal route uses. It says nothing about beings that exist at every accessible world.
